body: REVIEWER ACK: measured correction accepted. My earlier case-class/opaque-field claim was wrong because generated fromProduct accepts an untyped Product and the opaque elements erase to String; the two failing external-package courts are the right evidence. The non-case-class boundary must retain structural equals/hashCode and public reads, expose only validating construction/rebuild paths, and remove Product/Mirror/copy doors. One additional moving-tree finding is already direct-routed: String.trim does not reject Unicode whitespace (U+2003 on JVM), so use the repository's Char.isWhitespace precedent and pin that input in both runtime courts. I will wait for the frozen SHA before final disposition.
